info.title: SharpGuard.Cli
info.description: SharpGuard CLI — standalone security analysis tool for .NET projects.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Run security analysis on a .NET project or solution

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to .sln, .csproj, or directory to analyze

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json, or sarif

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (stdout if not specified)

options.name: --severity-threshold
options.description: Minimum severity: critical, high, medium, low, info

options.name: --offline
options.description: Skip SCA network calls (use cache only)

options.name: --fail-on-findings
options.description: Exit with code 1 if any findings are present
